review_notes: Read the whole target file and compared it with sibling files that use the same slice-wise Serrin mollifier: PartV/SerrinSpaceTimeMollify.lean (serrinSM_tendsto_prod, the private serrin_eLpNorm_rpow_eq, serrinRadius) and LPS/CrossEndpointPairingSlice.lean (private lps_eLpNorm_mollify_le). The target contains only one main theorem and a small helper, so there is no repetition inside it. The repetition is between the target and these files. I did not check whether every other use of the Young bound in the repo (about 25 files) has the same shape. I only judged the three listed above to be near-identical. The proposed lemma statements have not been compiled. The import direction is fine because the target already imports SerrinSpaceTimeMollify, so a lemma placed there is visible.

findings.problem: The domination bullet (lines 110-136) re-proves the same slice-level estimate that `serrinSM_tendsto_prod` proves for a space-time field in SerrinSpaceTimeMollify.lean, lines 176-198. In both places the proof uses the Young contraction `young_convolution_nonneg_integral_one_of_aemeasurable` with the same 8-argument mollifier boilerplate, then `simpa [CKN.mollify, CKN.mollifier]`, then `eLpNorm_sub_le` and `two_mul; gcongr`, to get `‖mollify g - g‖_q ≤ 2‖g‖_q`. The convergence bullet (lines 139-151) repeats the other half of that proof (SerrinSpaceTimeMollify.lean, lines 208-222). Both call `tendsto_eLpNorm_sub_zero_mollify` and then compose with `ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const` after rewriting `0 = 0 ^ r`. The contraction step is also proved a third time as the private `lps_eLpNorm_mollify_le` in CrossEndpointPairingSlice.lean, lines 56-67. There is no shared public lemma, so the contraction/triangle argument exists in three copies and the convergence/rpow argument in two. Any change to the mollifier API (kernel, radius or Young statement) has to be repeated in every copy.
findings.proposed_change:
In SerrinSpaceTimeMollify.lean, after `serrinSM` and before `serrinSM_tendsto_prod`, add two public slice lemmas. For `q : ℝ≥0∞` with `1 ≤ q` and `q ≠ ⊤`, they would read:

1. `serrin_eLpNorm_mollify_le (hq) (hqtop) {g : Vec3 → ℝ} (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g volume) (n : ℕ) : eLpNorm (CKN.mollify g (serrinRadius n) (serrinRadius_pos n)) q volume ≤ eLpNorm g q volume`. The proof is the existing body of `lps_eLpNorm_mollify_le`. The private copy in CrossEndpointPairingSlice.lean can then be deleted.
2. `serrin_eLpNorm_mollify_sub_le (hq) (hqtop) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g volume) (hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (CKN.mollify g (serrinRadius n) (serrinRadius_pos n)) volume) (n) : eLpNorm (fun x => CKN.mollify g (serrinRadius n) (serrinRadius_pos n) x - g x) q volume ≤ 2 * eLpNorm g q volume`. The proof is `eLpNorm_sub_le hq` followed by lemma 1 and `two_mul; gcongr`.

Optionally add a corollary that raises both sides to the power `r` with `ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow` and `ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg`. Its statement would be `eLpNorm (fun x => mollify g … x - g x) q volume ^ r ≤ 2 ^ r * eLpNorm g q volume ^ r`.

Rewritten use in the target (domination bullet, lines 110-136): after `filter_upwards [hfSlice] with t ht`, set `hsm := (hsmSliceAE-style measurability of serrinSM f n (·,t))`. This is already needed for `hEq`, so extract it once as a `have`. Then `calc N n t ^ p ≤ (2 * eLpNorm (fun x => f (x,t)) _ volume) ^ p := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (serrin_eLpNorm_mollify_sub_le (ENNReal.one_le_ofReal.mpr hq) hqtop ht.aestronglyMeasurable hsm n) (by positivity)`, and then keep the existing `_ = 2 ^ p * … := ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg …` step. This removes the `hmol`, `hmol'` and `htri` blocks.

Rewritten use in `serrinSM_tendsto_prod` (lines 176-205): the same lemma replaces `hmol`, `htri` and the `gcongr`/`simpa` step, with `p` in place of `ENNReal.ofReal q`.

For the convergence half, add `serrin_tendsto_eLpNorm_rpow (hq) (hqtop) (hg : MemLp g q volume) (hr : 0 < r) : Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (fun x => mollify g (serrinRadius n) (serrinRadius_pos n) x - g x) q volume ^ r) atTop (𝓝 0)`. Its proof is `tendsto_eLpNorm_sub_zero_mollify`, then `(ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.tendsto 0).comp`, then `ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos`. Both the target (lines 140-151) and SerrinSpaceTimeMollify.lean (lines 209-222) then close their third DCT bullet with one application of it.
findings.benefit: The Young-contraction, triangle and rpow-continuity argument is written once and named. The main theorem's DCT hypotheses then read as the three facts they are: bounded by `2^p ‖f‖^p`, integrable bound, and pointwise convergence. The 7-line mollifier-hypothesis block no longer appears in the target. A later change to `CKN.mollifier` or the Young lemma needs one edit rather than three. The mixed-norm and space-time `L^p` theorems visibly use the same slice estimates.
